aub_upgrade_chain_temple_01_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = temple_01
			aub_can_upgrade_to_temple_02_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = main_building_tier_2_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = temple_01
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = temple_02 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = main_building_tier_2_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = temple_02
			aub_can_upgrade_to_temple_03_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = main_building_tier_3_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = temple_02
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = temple_03 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = main_building_tier_3_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = temple_03
			aub_can_upgrade_to_temple_04_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = main_building_tier_4_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = temple_03
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = temple_04 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = main_building_tier_4_cost }
		}
	}
}
